remainingIssues: Condenser type selectable values are not defined; the requirement says 'select a condenser type' but does not list allowed options.

Scope conflict: the selector is described as relevant for 'air-cooled DX systems' but the visibility rule is 'when the selected system uses a DX cooling coil'; it is unclear whether it applies to all DX systems or only air-cooled DX systems.
Field behavior for non-DX systems is not specified (hidden, disabled, or reset/cleared).
No default value is specified for the condenser type when a DX coil is selected, nor whether it persists across coil-type changes.
Validation and saving behavior is unspecified, including whether the value must be cleared when switching from DX to non-DX and whether invalid combinations are blocked at save.
rationale: The interpreted requirement lacks the condenser-type domain values, has an unresolved scope conflict between air-cooled DX and all DX systems, and omits default value, non-DX UX behavior, and save/validation behavior. These gaps are implementation-blocking.
